results.title: Wawasan: Najib's conditional pardon must be respected by all parties
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Parti Wawasan Negara (Wawasan) has welcomed the conditional pardon granted to former prime minister Datuk Seri Najib Razak, saying the decision by His Majesty Sultan Ibrahim, King of Malaysia, should be respected by all parties.
